description: Read emails the watched brands sent, newest first, a page at a time: subject, type, subtype, sentAt, collectedAt, brand, url and a breakdown (analysis, null until analyzed). Pass domain for one brand and since for emails sent at or after a time (for example the start of this week). Emails arrive a few hours after they are sent, so when polling set since about a day before the last check and skip ids already seen. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for older emails. Each url also works as the url of create_template_from_example to remix it. Requires templates:read.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, for older emails. Omit for the newest.

domain.description: Only this watched brand, by website or domain, such as linear.app.

limit.description: Emails per page, 1 to 60. Defaults to 24.

since.description: Only emails sent at or after this ISO 8601 date or time, such as 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

name: list_watched_brand_emails

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_watched_brand_emails` MCP tool.

emails.description: Emails from watched brands, newest sent first: id, subject, preheader, type, subtype, sentAt, collectedAt (when the gallery received it), brand (name, domain, slug), url (also accepted by create_template_from_example) and analysis (null until analyzed): the same breakdown as list_email_references.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for older emails; null on the last page.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
